identificationModule.briefTitle: Study to Determine if BHV-1300 is Effective and Safe in Adults With Graves' Disease
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 3, Double-blind, Multicenter, Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Study to Evaluate the Efficacy, Safety and Tolerability of BHV-1300 in the Treatment of Adults With Graves' Disease

armGroups.label: BHV-1300
armGroups.description: BHV-1300 is delivered subcutaneously via autoinjector. Participants will be randomized in a 2:1 ratio to receive either BHV-1300 or placebo.

armGroups.label: Placebo
armGroups.description: Matching placebo is delivered subcutaneously via autoinjector. Participants will be randomized in a 2:1 ratio to receive either BHV-1300 or placebo.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of participants on BHV-1300 vs placebo who are not on an antithyroid drug and with normal thyroid function (total T3, free T4 (FT4), & TSH within normal limits) at Week 26.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of participants on BHV-1300 vs placebo who are not on an antithyroid drug and with normal thyroid hormone (Total T3 and FT4) at Week 26.
Change from baseline in TRAb (TBII) of participants on BHV-1300 vs placebo at Week 6
Change from baseline in TRAb (TBII) of participants on BHV-1300 vs placebo at Week 26
Exposure-adjusted Cumulative ATD dose, of participants on BHV-1300 vs placebo at Week 26
Time to normal thyroid hormones (defined as Total T3 & FT4 within normal limits) and off ATD of participants on BHV-1300 vs placebo
Time to euthyroidism (defined as Total T3, FT4, and TSH within normal limits) and off ATD of participants on BHV-1300 vs placebo
Change from baseline in Total IgG of participants on BHV-1300 vs placebo at Week 6
Change from baseline in Total IgG of participants on BHV-1300 vs placebo at Week 26
Number of participants who are TRAb seronegative (defined as TRAb < ULN) at Week 26
Number of participants who are euthyroid (defined as Total T3, FT4, and TSH within normal limits), off ATD and TRAb seronegative at Week 26
Number of unique participants with SAEs, moderate and severe AEs, AEs leading to discontinuation or deaths
Number of unique participants with Grade 3 to 4 lab abnormalities
